senses.gloss: (b. h.) to break forth, shine; to bloom, sprout, grow.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite> <he>היה … ועמוד אש צוֹמֵחַ</he> the pillar of cloud came down, and the pillar of fire grew brighter.
<cite ref="Chullin 60b:6">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>יצאו דשאים … וצָמְחוּ</he> the plants came out and stood at the opening of the ground, until Adam prayed, when rain came down, and they came forth.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 46:1">Pesik. R. s. 46</cite> <he>צָמְחָה כפרתו</he> his pardon was revealed.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 9:1:11">Y. Shebi. IX, 38ᵈ</cite> top <he>אם צמחו מוצאי וכ׳</he> if the leaves came out after the Sabbatical year.
Ib. אם צימח וכ׳ if it (the lof in the ground) sprouted again &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:3">Maasr. I, 3</cite> <he>התלתן כדי שתִּצְמַח</he> Ms. M. fenugrec is subject to tithes when it is so far advanced that the seeds can be planted and will grow; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 12b">R. Hash. 12ᵇ</cite>, expl. <he>משתצמח לזרעים</he> when it has grown sufficiently to be planted (Rashi: when its seeds begin to develop).

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 10:3">Neg. X, 3</cite> <he>הצומח</he> a black hair that grows out of the sore (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:37">Lev. XIII, 37</cite>). Tosef. ib. IV, 1 <he>שתי שערות צומחות</he> two black hairs of recent growth. Ib. <he>אחת צוֹמַחַת וכ׳</he> one of recent growth, and the other (of old standing) surrounded with flesh; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be made to grow forth; to grow.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> <he>נ׳ להם גואל וכ׳</he> a redeemer grew up for them and redeemed them.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 12">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XII</cite> <he>נִצְמָהִין מאליהן</he> grew of themselves (without being planted); a. e.

senses.gloss: to grow. Y. Shebi. l. c., v. supra. Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ top (ref. to Deut. XIV, 22) דבר שהוא נזרע ומְצַמֵּחַ (R. S. to Maasr. I, 3 ומצְמִיחִ) that (is subject to tithes) which is sufficiently advanced to grow when planted (v. supra); a. e.
